longTitle.officialTitle: To amend the Mineral Leasing Act to extend the period of time during which the Secretary of the Interior is required to collect a fee for each new application for a permit to drill, and for other purposes.

enactingFormula.i: Be it enacted by the Senate and House of Representa­tives of the United States of America in Congress assembled,

section.heading: SHORT TITLE.
section.content: This Act may be cited as the “License to Drill Act”.

section.heading: BLM OIL AND GAS PERMIT PROCESSING FEE.
section.chapeau: Section 35(d) of the Mineral Leasing Act (30 U.S.C. 191(d)) is amended—

paragraph.content: in paragraph (1), by striking “2026” and inserting “2037”;

subparagraph.content: by striking “Of the fees collected under this subsection for a fiscal year, the” and inserting “The”; and

by striking “transfer—” and all that follows through “the Fund” and inserting “transfer, for each of fiscal years 2027 through 2037, all of the fees collected under this subsection for each such fiscal year to the BLM Permit Processing Improvement Fund”; and

paragraph.content: in paragraph (4), by striking “2026” and inserting “2037”.

signature.role: Speaker of the House of Representatives.
Vice President of the United States and President of the Senate.
